results.title: Delphi Technique in Health Sciences: A Map
results.content: In one review based on 10 Delphi studies from health sciences (ID7), the authors discovered that the number of experts per round was stated in all articles. One review of Delphi techniques in a health context determined that the criteria for selecting the experts was reproduced in 65 of 100 articles (65%) (ID3) included in that particular review. The number of experts included varied in the Delphi studies investigated in the reviews from three (ID1) to 731 experts (ID11). In a review of 100 Delphi studies (ID3), for example, 88.9% of the authors defined consensus in advance of development of the questionnaire. As indicated in one review, the experts received no feedback at all in 9% of the Delphi studies investigated (ID4). Keywords: Delphi technique, method, health sciences, consensus, systematic review, map, methodological discussion, expert survey. Citation: Niederberger M and Spranger J (2020) Delphi Technique in Health Sciences: A Map. doi: 10.3389/fpubh.2020.00457.
